shots.content: Inside a café, a rectangular table stands beside the window, with a tall floor plant near one end and the counter beyond the other; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. There is one empty place. A woman in an orange shirt sits in the counter-side window seat and poses a puzzling riddle. A woman in a blue shirt sits in the plant-side aisle seat. A woman in a yellow shirt sits in the counter-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the café counter end, looking along the rectangular table toward the floor plant, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats and the floor plant in frame.

shots.content: A man in a white shirt enters and sits in the empty place. A woman in an orange shirt asks for the answer to the riddle, and he replies that guessing is not the same as knowing.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A woman in an orange shirt asks about solving the riddle, and a woman in a yellow shirt answers that the phrasing is contradictory.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the rectangular table.
